label: GEMINI_L5_COHORT_RUNNER_V1

report.label: GEMINI_L5_CONTINUOUS_RUN_V1

probe_spec.label: GEMINI_LIVE_PROBE_SPEC_V1
probe_spec.live_cohort_note: carried but NOT in spec_sha, for the same reason as auth_id: a readiness run and its live counterpart are one experiment, and folding the granted budget ledger into the experiment's identity would move the hash at the moment of the grant
probe_spec.auth_id_note: carried but NOT in spec_sha: readiness runs with the sentinel and live with the grant, so folding it in would make the readiness==live invariant unprovable by construction

report.quote_band_note: null means the frozen lane's own quote_between_tte_s is in force unmodified. A band is a declared, hashed experiment parameter; there is no default and no environment variable.

cohort.label: GEMINI_MUTATION_COHORT_V1
cohort.note: COHORT-2 window 01 of 20. One WHOLE 12-action ledger per bound BTC15m contract; unspent slots expire with that contract and are never inherited by the next one.
cohort.labels: the cohort budget is a TIGHTENING of the envelope, never an extension of it. No rollover, no automatic successor.

coherence_readers.why: the gate explains a disappearance from these two reads plus filled history; if either is unreadable, an unexplained order stops the window instead of being assumed away

inventory.labels: matched-pair economics, directional-residual P&L, fees, rebates and settlement cashflow are accounted SEPARATELY and never summed into one number. Nothing here is REALIZED: a cost basis is not a profit and settlement has not paid.

pre_latch_recovery.budget_note: max(ledger 0, venue 0): a disagreement is always read upward

outstanding.labels: only this read releases committed cash. A cancel ack is a receipt, not a release.

reconciliation.label: GEMINI_POSITION_LEDGER_V1
reconciliation.implies_model: B or C -- nothing is held, so it netted or was cashed out
reconciliation.matched_label: our_matched is OUR OWN bookkeeping. Until the venue representation is resolved it is NOT confirmed state and must not be reported as Gemini economics.

authorization.labels: an authorization names an EXECUTABLE and an ENVELOPE. Editing either after review invalidates it, which is the point: approval attaches to what was read, not to a name.

bundle.labels: executable_sha covers the driver's BOUNDS; bundle_sha covers the ORDERING too. Both are named by an authorization, because undoing either has cost a live authorization before.

latch_pushable.why: the cohort proved this before it consumed the grant's latch

latch.when: spent once, durably, before the COHORT's first mutation
latch.why: one owner authorization covers this cohort; per-window mutations are bounded by the cohort's shared append-only ledger and by its aggregate loss stop

decision_capture.note: EVIDENCE ONLY. Each wrapper makes the same call with the same arguments, returns the same object and propagates every exception. It adds no decision, no mutation and no bound; every limit is still enforced inside ws_continuous.Driver. The driver now RETURNS the market state it decided on, which moved its executable_sha -- an additive key nothing reads back, not a change to what it decides.

window.residual_note: any residual is CARRIED directional exposure, reconciled through settlement. No taker cross was introduced to flatten it.
window.inert_note: FLAT ORDERS is not flat INVENTORY. inert:false means at least one strategy-owned order may still be executable; inert:true means the venue showed none resting and says nothing about fills already taken.

unreadable.note: a HOLD costs one cycle and no mutation. Nothing was placed, replaced or cancelled on an unreadable snapshot, and inventory was never assumed flat.

window.realized_note: REALIZED stays null until a venue-confirmed cash movement is read back. settlement_report keeps matched-pair and directional-residual apart.

refresh_link.note: reads are attributed by each refresh's own reconcile_attempts; any read after the last refresh belongs to terminal withdrawal

book_capture.labels: a cycle with no readable presented book is a cycle the controller quoted nothing in; UNREADABLE is recorded, never replaced with an empty book.

decision_capture.note: EVIDENCE ONLY. Each wrapper makes the same call with the same arguments, returns the same object and propagates every exception. It adds no decision, no mutation and no bound; every limit is still enforced inside ws_continuous.Driver. The driver now RETURNS the market state it decided on, which moved its executable_sha -- an additive key nothing reads back, not a change to what it decides.

cohort.labels: the cohort budget is a TIGHTENING of the envelope, never an extension of it. No rollover, no automatic successor.

coherence_readers.why: the gate explains a disappearance from these two reads plus filled history; if either is unreadable, an unexplained order stops the window instead of being assumed away

inventory.labels: matched-pair economics, directional-residual P&L, fees, rebates and settlement cashflow are accounted SEPARATELY and never summed into one number. Nothing here is REALIZED: a cost basis is not a profit and settlement has not paid.

pre_latch_recovery.budget_note: max(ledger 0, venue 0): a disagreement is always read upward

outstanding.labels: only this read releases committed cash. A cancel ack is a receipt, not a release.

reconciliation.label: GEMINI_POSITION_LEDGER_V1
reconciliation.implies_model: B or C -- nothing is held, so it netted or was cashed out
reconciliation.matched_label: our_matched is OUR OWN bookkeeping. Until the venue representation is resolved it is NOT confirmed state and must not be reported as Gemini economics.

authorization.labels: an authorization names an EXECUTABLE and an ENVELOPE. Editing either after review invalidates it, which is the point: approval attaches to what was read, not to a name.

bundle.labels: executable_sha covers the driver's BOUNDS; bundle_sha covers the ORDERING too. Both are named by an authorization, because undoing either has cost a live authorization before.

latch_pushable.why: the cohort proved this before it consumed the grant's latch

latch.when: spent once, durably, before the COHORT's first mutation
latch.why: one owner authorization covers this cohort; per-window mutations are bounded by the cohort's shared append-only ledger and by its aggregate loss stop

window.residual_note: any residual is CARRIED directional exposure, reconciled through settlement. No taker cross was introduced to flatten it.
window.inert_note: FLAT ORDERS is not flat INVENTORY. inert:false means at least one strategy-owned order may still be executable; inert:true means the venue showed none resting and says nothing about fills already taken.

unreadable.note: a HOLD costs one cycle and no mutation. Nothing was placed, replaced or cancelled on an unreadable snapshot, and inventory was never assumed flat.

window.realized_note: REALIZED stays null until a venue-confirmed cash movement is read back. settlement_report keeps matched-pair and directional-residual apart.

refresh_link.note: reads are attributed by each refresh's own reconcile_attempts; any read after the last refresh belongs to terminal withdrawal

book_capture.labels: a cycle with no readable presented book is a cycle the controller quoted nothing in; UNREADABLE is recorded, never replaced with an empty book.

decision_capture.note: EVIDENCE ONLY. Each wrapper makes the same call with the same arguments, returns the same object and propagates every exception. It adds no decision, no mutation and no bound; every limit is still enforced inside ws_continuous.Driver. The driver now RETURNS the market state it decided on, which moved its executable_sha -- an additive key nothing reads back, not a change to what it decides.

resolution.labels: the OUTCOME leg only. A settled contract says what it resolved to, never what our account received; realized P&L still requires authenticated cash reconciliation. UNCONFIRMED means no read showed a settlement, NOT that none occurred.

fee_provenance.note: an execution with no `n` contributes nothing and is COUNTED here: absent is unknown, never zero

fill_provenance.note: VERIFIED, not assumed from post-only. An execution with no `m` is UNKNOWN and is never counted as maker.

economics.rebates_note: CREDITED rebates only. None read back means None, not zero: an assumed rebate is exactly the kind of number that makes a bad trade look profitable.
economics.realized_note: REALIZED requires an attributable cash movement read back from the account. Nothing here is it.
economics.why: the contract has not settled, so its payout is UNKNOWN and is not guessed. It contributes NOTHING to cohort economic loss; its risk is bounded by the per-market committed, residual and exposure gates inside the driver.

report.quote_band_note: null means the frozen lane's own quote_between_tte_s is in force unmodified. A band is a declared, hashed experiment parameter; there is no default and no environment variable.

cohort.labels: the cohort budget is a TIGHTENING of the envelope, never an extension of it. No rollover, no automatic successor.

outstanding.labels: only this read releases committed cash. A cancel ack is a receipt, not a release.

authorization.labels: an authorization names an EXECUTABLE and an ENVELOPE. Editing either after review invalidates it, which is the point: approval attaches to what was read, not to a name.

bundle.labels: executable_sha covers the driver's BOUNDS; bundle_sha covers the ORDERING too. Both are named by an authorization, because undoing either has cost a live authorization before.

latch_pushable.why: the cohort proved this before it consumed the grant's latch

latch.when: spent once, durably, before the COHORT's first mutation
latch.why: one owner authorization covers this cohort; per-window mutations are bounded by the cohort's shared append-only ledger and by its aggregate loss stop

decision_capture.note: EVIDENCE ONLY. Each wrapper makes the same call with the same arguments, returns the same object and propagates every exception. window.residual_note: any residual is CARRIED directional exposure, reconciled through settlement. No taker cross was introduced to flatten it.
window.inert_note: FLAT ORDERS is not flat INVENTORY. inert:false means at least one strategy-owned order may still be executable; inert:true means the venue showed none resting and says nothing about fills already taken.

unreadable.note: a HOLD costs one cycle and no mutation. Nothing was placed, replaced or cancelled on an unreadable snapshot, and inventory was never assumed flat.

window.realized_note: REALIZED stays null until a venue-confirmed cash movement is read back. settlement_report keeps matched-pair and directional-residual apart.

book_capture.labels: a cycle with no readable presented book is a cycle the controller quoted nothing in; UNREADABLE is recorded, never replaced with an empty book.

decision_capture.note: EVIDENCE ONLY. Each wrapper makes the same call with the same arguments, returns the same object and propagates every exception. It adds no decision, no mutation and no bound; every limit is still enforced inside ws_continuous.Driver. The driver now RETURNS the market state it decided on, which moved its executable_sha -- an additive key nothing reads back, not a change to what it decides.

decision_capture.note: EVIDENCE ONLY. Each wrapper makes the same call with the same arguments, returns the same object and propagates every exception. probe_spec.live_cohort_note: carried but NOT in spec_sha, for the same reason as auth_id: a readiness run and its live counterpart are one experiment, and folding the granted budget ledger into the experiment's identity would move the hash at the moment of the grant
probe_spec.auth_id_note: carried but NOT in spec_sha: readiness runs with the sentinel and live with the grant, so folding it in would make the readiness==live invariant unprovable by construction

report.quote_band_note: null means the frozen lane's own quote_between_tte_s is in force unmodified. A band is a declared, hashed experiment parameter; there is no default and no environment variable.

cohort.label: GEMINI_MUTATION_COHORT_V1
cohort.note: COHORT-2 window 08 of 20. One WHOLE 12-action ledger per bound BTC15m contract; unspent slots expire with that contract and are never inherited by the next one.
cohort.labels: the cohort budget is a TIGHTENING of the envelope, never an extension of it. No rollover, no automatic successor.

coherence_readers.why: the gate explains a disappearance from these two reads plus filled history; if either is unreadable, an unexplained order stops the window instead of being assumed away

inventory.labels: matched-pair economics, directional-residual P&L, fees, rebates and settlement cashflow are accounted SEPARATELY and never summed into one number. Nothing here is REALIZED: a cost basis is not a profit and settlement has not paid.

pre_latch_recovery.budget_note: max(ledger 0, venue 0): a disagreement is always read upward

outstanding.labels: only this read releases committed cash. A cancel ack is a receipt, not a release.

reconciliation.label: GEMINI_POSITION_LEDGER_V1
reconciliation.implies_model: B or C -- nothing is held, so it netted or was cashed out
reconciliation.matched_label: our_matched is OUR OWN bookkeeping. Until the venue representation is resolved it is NOT confirmed state and must not be reported as Gemini economics.

authorization.labels: an authorization names an EXECUTABLE and an ENVELOPE. Editing either after review invalidates it, which is the point: approval attaches to what was read, not to a name.

bundle.labels: executable_sha covers the driver's BOUNDS; bundle_sha covers the ORDERING too. Both are named by an authorization, because undoing either has cost a live authorization before.

latch_pushable.why: the cohort proved this before it consumed the grant's latch

latch.when: spent once, durably, before the COHORT's first mutation
latch.why: one owner authorization covers this cohort; per-window mutations are bounded by the cohort's shared append-only ledger and by its aggregate loss stop

window.residual_note: any residual is CARRIED directional exposure, reconciled through settlement. No taker cross was introduced to flatten it.
window.inert_note: FLAT ORDERS is not flat INVENTORY. inert:false means at least one strategy-owned order may still be executable; inert:true means the venue showed none resting and says nothing about fills already taken.

unreadable.note: a HOLD costs one cycle and no mutation. Nothing was placed, replaced or cancelled on an unreadable snapshot, and inventory was never assumed flat.

window.realized_note: REALIZED stays null until a venue-confirmed cash movement is read back. settlement_report keeps matched-pair and directional-residual apart.

refresh_link.note: reads are attributed by each refresh's own reconcile_attempts; any read after the last refresh belongs to terminal withdrawal

book_capture.labels: a cycle with no readable presented book is a cycle the controller quoted nothing in; UNREADABLE is recorded, never replaced with an empty book.

decision_capture.note: EVIDENCE ONLY. Each wrapper makes the same call with the same arguments, returns the same object and propagates every exception. It adds no decision, no mutation and no bound; every limit is still enforced inside ws_continuous.Driver. The driver now RETURNS the market state it decided on, which moved its executable_sha -- an additive key nothing reads back, not a change to what it decides.

resolution.labels: the OUTCOME leg only. A settled contract says what it resolved to, never what our account received; realized P&L still requires authenticated cash reconciliation. UNCONFIRMED means no read showed a settlement, NOT that none occurred.

fee_provenance.note: an execution with no `n` contributes nothing and is COUNTED here: absent is unknown, never zero

fill_provenance.note: VERIFIED, not assumed from post-only. An execution with no `m` is UNKNOWN and is never counted as maker.

economics.rebates_note: CREDITED rebates only. None read back means None, not zero: an assumed rebate is exactly the kind of number that makes a bad trade look profitable.
economics.realized_note: REALIZED requires an attributable cash movement read back from the account. Nothing here is it.
economics.why: the contract has not settled, so its payout is UNKNOWN and is not guessed. It contributes NOTHING to cohort economic loss; its risk is bounded by the per-market committed, residual and exposure gates inside the driver.

probe_spec.auth_id_note: carried but NOT in spec_sha: readiness runs with the sentinel and live with the grant, so folding it in would make the readiness==live invariant unprovable by construction

report.quote_band_note: null means the frozen lane's own quote_between_tte_s is in force unmodified. A band is a declared, hashed experiment parameter; there is no default and no environment variable.

cohort.note: COHORT-2 window 09 of 20. One WHOLE 12-action ledger per bound BTC15m contract; unspent slots expire with that contract and are never inherited by the next one.
cohort.labels: the cohort budget is a TIGHTENING of the envelope, never an extension of it. No rollover, no automatic successor.

reconciliation.matched_label: our_matched is OUR OWN bookkeeping. Until the venue representation is resolved it is NOT confirmed state and must not be reported as Gemini economics.

authorization.labels: an authorization names an EXECUTABLE and an ENVELOPE. Editing either after review invalidates it, which is the point: approval attaches to what was read, not to a name.

bundle.labels: executable_sha covers the driver's BOUNDS; bundle_sha covers the ORDERING too. Both are named by an authorization, because undoing either has cost a live authorization before.

latch_pushable.why: the cohort proved this before it consumed the grant's latch

latch.when: spent once, durably, before the COHORT's first mutation
latch.why: one owner authorization covers this cohort; per-window mutations are bounded by the cohort's shared append-only ledger and by its aggregate loss stop

window.realized_note: REALIZED stays null until a venue-confirmed cash movement is read back. settlement_report keeps matched-pair and directional-residual apart.

book_capture.labels: a cycle with no readable presented book is a cycle the controller quoted nothing in; UNREADABLE is recorded, never replaced with an empty book.

decision_capture.note: EVIDENCE ONLY. Each wrapper makes the same call with the same arguments, returns the same object and propagates every exception. It adds no decision, no mutation and no bound; every limit is still enforced inside ws_continuous.Driver. window.residual_note: any residual is CARRIED directional exposure, reconciled through settlement. No taker cross was introduced to flatten it.
window.inert_note: FLAT ORDERS is not flat INVENTORY. inert:false means at least one strategy-owned order may still be executable; inert:true means the venue showed none resting and says nothing about fills already taken.

unreadable.note: a HOLD costs one cycle and no mutation. Nothing was placed, replaced or cancelled on an unreadable snapshot, and inventory was never assumed flat.

window.realized_note: REALIZED stays null until a venue-confirmed cash movement is read back. settlement_report keeps matched-pair and directional-residual apart.

refresh_link.note: reads are attributed by each refresh's own reconcile_attempts; any read after the last refresh belongs to terminal withdrawal

book_capture.labels: a cycle with no readable presented book is a cycle the controller quoted nothing in; UNREADABLE is recorded, never replaced with an empty book.

decision_capture.note: EVIDENCE ONLY. Each wrapper makes the same call with the same arguments, returns the same object and propagates every exception. It adds no decision, no mutation and no bound; every limit is still enforced inside ws_continuous.Driver. The driver now RETURNS the market state it decided on, which moved its executable_sha -- an additive key nothing reads back, not a change to what it decides.

authorization.labels: an authorization names an EXECUTABLE and an ENVELOPE. Editing either after review invalidates it, which is the point: approval attaches to what was read, not to a name.

bundle.labels: executable_sha covers the driver's BOUNDS; bundle_sha covers the ORDERING too. Both are named by an authorization, because undoing either has cost a live authorization before.

latch_pushable.why: the cohort proved this before it consumed the grant's latch

latch.when: spent once, durably, before the COHORT's first mutation
latch.why: one owner authorization covers this cohort; per-window mutations are bounded by the cohort's shared append-only ledger and by its aggregate loss stop

economics.labels: cumulative_economic_loss_usd and max_drawdown_usd are the ONLY two fields the cohort stops read, and both are computed over SETTLED windows only. A profitable window carries a NEGATIVE loss and reduces it. Pending windows contribute nothing -- their risk lives in the per-market gates. Unrecoverable windows contribute nothing and are never estimated from turnover. REALIZED stays null until attributable cash is read back.
